name: Murino: The Fog Is Coming
storyline: In the endless district of Murino, a courier in Building P-352 tries to survive another day of routine deliveries. What begins as ordinary work soon turns into something far more dangerous. The apartment blocks stretch endlessly into the fog, the courtyards repeat like a maze, and every familiar path becomes less trustworthy with each trip. As the Fog closes in and the Samosbor makes the city even more hostile, a simple delivery route turns into a desperate struggle to make it back home.
summary:
Murino: The Fog Is Coming is an atmospheric first-person horror game about the life of a courier in the endless district of Murino, where apartment blocks disappear into the fog, familiar routes stop being reliable, and an ordinary delivery job slowly turns into a fight for survival.

The player lives in one of Murino’s apartments, in Building P-352, and works as a courier. Each day begins as routine - accept an order, leave the apartment, pass through entrances, courtyards, and service corridors, reach the destination, and return home. But in Murino, even the simplest job quickly becomes dangerous. The buildings seem to stretch on forever, the courtyards all look the same, and the Fog and the Samosbor make every familiar path less and less safe.
